name: @printkit/sdk
description: TypeScript client for the printkit print service

scripts.gen:types: UPDATE_TS=1 cargo test --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml -p printkit-protocol --features typescript --test typescript
scripts.gen: pnpm run gen:types && pnpm run gen:methods
scripts.build: pnpm run gen && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/verify.mjs
scripts.check:types: pnpm run gen:types && git diff --exit-code -- src/types.ts
